children: The Japanese equities market's performance is likely to broaden from here, two analysts at Goldman Sachs Research say in a research report. The analysts identify five key investment themes for 2027: artificial-intelligence dispersion, corporate restructuring, physical AI, energy and resource security, and cybersecurity. "Top-down pressure on corporate Japan to use excess cash reserves to invest in growth initiatives" will probably intensify, the analysts say. There seems to be a coordinated focus in Japan on growth, which is expected to create more event-driven opportunities around corporate restructuring, mergers and acquisitions, and sector consolidation, the analysts add. GS's three-, six- and 12-month targets for Topix index are 4200, 4300 and 4500, respectively. Topix index is 1.4% lower at 3847.11 (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
